messages:
marta (sales): Heads-up — NorthStar Health wants a 2-week POC starting next Mon. Key asks: EU-only for primary traffic, DR failover to us-west only on region outage, BYO-KMS for customer keys, and an explicit subprocessors list for the EU region. They also want a rough cross-region egress cost estimate and confirmation we can pin a tenant to eu-west-1. cc @raj @kevin

raj (solutions): Copy. Can we support tenant pinning + BYO-KMS without private deployment? any infra constraints?

kevin (infra): Short answer: yes for pinning to eu-west-1 on Dedicated or Private. Hosted-tier can do region affinity but not strict pinned tenancy (we have soft-affinity + failover). BYO-KMS: hosted supports BYO-KMS for control-plane metadata only; for full key isolation we need Dedicated or Private.

marta (sales): Customer prefers hosted but is open to Dedicated if price delta is reasonable. Need clear differentiation we can send to procurement (pricing + lead time).

sam (billing): For Dedicated: rough delta is base reserved capacity + 20% premium over hosted for regional pin + BYO-KMS HSM integration. For a 2-week POC we can do a short-term Dedicated trial — ops team needs a ticket. Egress: estimate ~0.09 USD/GB cross-region for eu->us for our current cloud partners; include cloud egress + routing surcharge.

elaine (legal): For subprocessors: we can provide the current EU-region subprocessor list (cloud infra + monitoring + analytics vendors). Will need customer NDA before sending full attestation doc. Also flag: BYO-KMS with customer-managed keys requires an updated DPA addendum.

marco (eng): From runtime side: we can set routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 and failover to us-west-2. Suggest a canary duration of 5min for failover tests. Sample routing policy (high-level):

```
policy:
  primary: eu-west-1
  failover: us-west-2
  sticky_ttl: 300s
  kms_mode: customer_managed
  kv_cache_locality: regional
```

kevin (infra): That policy looks fine. For the POC we should disable automatic cross-region cache warming to avoid unexpected egress. Also ops-bot: open a POC-Dedicated trial ticket and tag netsec for egress rules.

ops-bot: Ticket created: POC-5201234567-DedicatedTrial. Owners: @kevin (infra), @raj (solutions). ETA for setup: 3 business days.

raj (solutions): Action items — @kevin to confirm Dedicated trial pricing and lead time; @sam to produce an estimated POC invoice (2 weeks); @elaine to prepare subprocessor list + DPA addendum; @marta to share procurement contact and expected start date. I'll draft the presales note for the customer.

marta (sales): Thanks — procurement contact is procurement@northstarhealth.example. Start date tentative Tue next week. If Dedicated + BYO-KMS pushes >25% we run executive approval.

sam (billing): I'll drop a ballpark PDF tonight, line items: reserved slot (2 weeks), BYO-KMS integration fee, cross-region egress estimate, support SLA upgrade.

elaine (legal): I'll queue the subprocessor export for NDA review. If they need certifications (ISO/GDPR attestation) we'll append our cert pack.

marco (eng): Quick perf note: if they route strictly to eu-west-1 with long sequences we should suggest a quantized model variant to keep latency predictable. I'll include recommended model/quant config in the presales doc.

marta (sales): Perfect. If anyone hits blockers ping me. Also customer asked if we can list the exact CSP peering points in EU — @kevin can you confirm node locations?

kevin (infra): Confirmed nodes: eu-west-1a, eu-west-1b at parity; we can provide colo POP list after ops ticket flow.

raj (solutions): I'll assemble the one-pager with pinning constraints, cost delta, timeline, and required legal artifacts. Expect a draft by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
